game.name: Nba 2k11 (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc:
Relive 10 of the most memorable games of Michael Jordan's career. If you can replicate the scenarios from these 10 legendary games, you'll unlock the MJ: A Legend in Action game mode.
The most realistic dribbling system on the market has been further enhanced to give you more fluid dribbling patterns than ever before, allowing you to dominate opponents with the same ease and grace as Michael Jordan.
Discover the many facets of an NBA player's career, on and off the court. and off the court. From press conferences to endorsements to transfer requests, there's more to your career than just a stat line.
With NBA Actu, not only can you follow the latest NBA news and stats while playing, but you'll also get a brand new halftime show for your games, plus new live commentary from the court, ...
